inputs.text: {"scene":"A straight-on studio photograph of a white plywood shelving unit built as a photographic calibration target, filling the entire tall frame from edge to edge with no visible floor or ceiling. Three horizontal tiers are divided by white shelf boards. The top tier holds, from left to right, an upright green printed circuit board against the back panel, four cast-iron gears decreasing in size and leaning against one another, a rusted five-pointed metal star, a tangled loop of galvanised chain, a black wire-mesh cup holding exactly eight felt-tip markers with red, yellow, green and blue caps, and a cobalt blue glass vase holding exactly three dahlias: one pale yellow, one deep magenta and one coral pink. Along the front edge, four wooden alphabet blocks display T, E, S, T from left to right in coloured serif type; a single white chicken egg rests at the center. The middle tier is dominated by two flat calibration charts propped side by side. The left chart has exactly twenty-four matte colour patches in four rows of six, a black frame and the small printed bottom-edge text \"COLOUR RENDITION CHART\". The right chart is a dense printed target of small colour and greyscale squares, with the legible numbers 1 to 22 in a row across the top and the letters A to L down both sides. Directly below both charts lies a long horizontal greyscale strip labeled \"GRAY SCALE\" with step numbers 1 to 19. On the bottom tier, from left to right, a brushed steel cocktail shaker is held by a hand entering at the left frame edge; a chrome stand holds exactly four white golf balls stacked in a pyramid; two dried ears of multicoloured corn rest beside a brown leather cylindrical case, a pair of black binoculars and a purple fabric box embroidered with a thin branch pattern. A single yellow sunflower on a tall green stem leans right. In the lower center, a round glass fish bowl half filled with water and purple gravel contains one blue betta fish, next to a yellow twin-bell alarm clock with a white face and hands showing ten past ten. At lower right, a terracotta pot of small green cacti and a blue glass bottle sit beside one orange, one lemon and one peach resting directly on the shelf board.
